hero.subtitle: Gift card information | Terms to be confirmed

description.title: Ask about options for gifting a flight
description.paragraph: Contact Flying Pictures to learn about current gift options. Before purchasing a card, confirm the package it covers, price, validity, activation and availability. If you already have a card, share its reference with our team to check its terms.

steps.title: Contact our team
steps.description: Tell us whether you want to gift a flight or already have a card.

steps.title: Confirm the terms
steps.description: Check the package, guests covered, price, validity and activation.

steps.title: Ask about availability
steps.description: Coordinate a date with our team according to the confirmed terms.
